I've confirmed it to Tobias in his DM: his standing call with Tansleigh Packaging for the Osprey rollout is now Fridays at 16:15.

His message is already in the knowledge brain (gbrain), saved as a fact from his direct message with me. It's tied to him, so only he can see it. I didn't save a second copy with the brain's "remember" tool, because that tool doesn't let me limit who sees the fact. Without that limit, his note could show up for other people, which would break the rule against sharing what someone tells me in a DM.

As he asked, I didn't change his calendar or tell anyone else.
